feature_contract.goal: Prevent post-HUD left/right backbuffers from being fed into SkyGlow when the user SkyGlow setting or the original game's active-glow flag transitions from OFF to ON after the first screen draw in the same Present.
feature_contract.scope_boundary: Only the R84 R30 first source-owned HUD/ESC draw boundary and stereo SkyGlow scene input; no HUD layout, world sky transforms, bloom intensity, FFB, DX11, DXVK, or R26_SAFE changes.
feature_contract.special_work_evidence: Previously R30CaptureSkyGlowSceneBeforeHud returned immediately while SkyGlowFactor<=0 or game-glow inactive, before stamping R30SkyGlowScreenDrawEpoch. R30ApplyStereoSkyGlow can then copy post-HUD eye buffers after a mid-frame OFF-to-ON transition, producing duplicate head-fixed bloom.
trace_stages: Original user SkyGlowFactor setting and game R30GameGlowActive render flags at first HUD/ESC screen producer.
R84 R33 pre-screen path and R30 original ScreenHud and XYZRHW eye capture source boundary on physical D3D9 Draw.
R30ApplyStereoSkyGlow at Present samples two clean reduced eye inputs, or fails closed when source was contaminated.
subcomponents: Record the first screen-draw present epoch before live glow-enable checks, including when actual pre-HUD copy is disabled.
Continue preserving exact per-eye capture, resource-epoch invalidation and Present fallback veto through enable changes.

acceptance_items.behavior_area: Screen producer to bilateral bloom input across OFF to ON
acceptance_items.expected_behavior: The first eligible ScreenHud or pause/ESC draw records its Present screen boundary even while user or game glow is disabled.

acceptance_items.behavior_area: SkyGlow Present under absent capture and Reset/resize
acceptance_items.expected_behavior: If no clean left and right SkyGlow source was acquired before HUD, the Present path skips bloom without sampling post-HUD buffers and preserves untouched original draw.

acceptance_items.behavior_area: R84 Windows game x86 x64 host source and packaging integration
acceptance_items.expected_behavior: Final validation-bearing exact SHA passes DX9Ex Active, Domain Isolation, HUD Inspector, and Full Source Impact gates without CI skip or Quest3 claims.

diagnosis.original_evidence: R30CaptureSkyGlowSceneBeforeHud original source checked SkyGlowFactor and R30GameGlowActive before recording the screen epoch, while R30ApplyStereoSkyGlow supports post-screen fallback when no boundary is recorded.
source_trace: ScreenHud and pause overlay producer enters R33 pre-screen/canonical XYZRHW physical draw.
R30CaptureSkyGlowSceneBeforeHud previously returns on disabled glow before R30SkyGlowScreenDrawEpoch assignment.
R30ApplyStereoSkyGlow at Present can see enabled glow and, without epoch veto, copy the now-painted left/right game backbuffers.
diagnosis.root_cause: Glow enable-state sampling and scene contamination source-boundary lifetime were coupled: an OFF first-UI frame transition lost the boundary identity needed for later Present fail-closed.
alternatives_rejected: Do not globally disable SkyGlow or blur, which would change accepted game visuals.
Do not perform a delayed post-HUD StretchRect or force GPU Flush, which would bloom ESC/score text.
Do not extend the source to all world billboards or untagged SkyGlow effects.
diagnosis.fix_evidence: Material renderer change at c5f52889 moves screen-epoch stamp before glow setting and game flag checks; mutation contract in existing source guard asserts stamping order and clean-eye fallback.
diagnosis.eye_ownership: The pre-HUD capture source remains two independent per-eye reduced textures. Without both clean sources, either eye cannot use a later HUD-painted backbuffer as bloom input.
diagnosis.evidence_limit: Source-owned OFF-to-ON within-Present case only; no claim to repair other sky WVP/headlock defects; Quest3/VDXR RUNTIME_VALIDATION=UNTESTED.
